mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_notice ( notice_seq, receiver_seq, notification_type, title, message, reference_id ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{receiverSeq}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{message}, #{referenceId} )
mapper.select: SELECT notice_seq AS notificationId, receiver_seq AS receiverSeq, notification_type AS notificationType, title, message, reference_id AS referenceId, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt FROM tbl_notice WHERE receiver_seq = #{receiverSeq} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notice_seq DESC
